description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConnectionController component of the OpenClaw project. It verifies behaviors such as default display name resolution, capability toggles, command inclusion/exclusion, operator connect options, and persistent connection state loading.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionControllerTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for GatewayConnectionController.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayNameSetsDefaultWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the default display name is set correctly when missing from UserDefaults.

methods.name: currentCapsReflectToggles
methods.description: Checks that capabilities reflect the toggled states based on UserDefaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsIncludeLocationWhenEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that location commands are included when location is enabled.

methods.name: currentCommandsExcludeDangerousSystemExecCommands
methods.description: Ensures that dangerous system execution commands are excluded in the current commands.

methods.name: operatorConnectOptionsOnlyRequestApprovalScopeWhenEnabled
methods.description: Tests that operator connect options include the approval scope only when enabled.

methods.name: operatorApprovalScopeRequestsStayBackwardCompatible
methods.description: Verifies backward compatibility of operator approval scope requests.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReadsSavedValues
methods.description: Checks that loading the last connection retrieves the saved values correctly.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReturnsNilForInvalidData
methods.description: Ensures that invalid stored data results in a nil return when loading last connection.
